environment.description: Same Django application deployed on EKS behind an NGINX Ingress Controller configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificate verification. The ingress annotation `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client: 'on'` is set with `auth-tls-secret` pointing to a CA bundle that only contains the internal PKI root CA (corp-internal-ca). Client certificates are issued exclusively to service accounts via HashiCorp Vault PKI engine with a max TTL of 1 hour and CN restricted to `*.svc.cluster.local` pattern. The ingress additionally sets `auth-tls-verify-depth: '2'` and `auth-tls-error-page: 'https://error.corp.example.com/403'`. Without a valid client certificate signed by the corp-internal-ca, the NGINX ingress terminates the TLS handshake at the transport layer before any HTTP data is transmitted to the backend pod. The Vault PKI role has `allowed_domains` set to `['docs-processor.svc.cluster.local']` with `allow_subdomains: false` and `enforce_hostnames: true`.
